answer: Mechanism: attestations between identities that appeared inside the same short window are discounted to near zero. The rule is temporal, not identity-based: fresh accounts may countersign, but their mutual signatures carry almost no weight until each has attested work from outside its own cohort. A hundred clones registered in one hour form a closed loop whose internal credit is worthless by construction. Breaking out forces the attacker to wander into genuinely older traffic, one account at a time, paying full price per identity - the shale and umber layer the defence rests on.
